name: @lingyu/windows-performance-monitor
description: Windows N-API addon for low-overhead CPU, memory, and temperature performance snapshots.
author: JNTMTMTM

scripts.build: node-gyp rebuild && dotnet publish temperature-helper/LingyuTemperatureReader.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true
scripts.rebuild: node-gyp clean && node-gyp rebuild && dotnet publish temperature-helper/LingyuTemperatureReader.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true
